rule_doc70_S6: Every PASS/FAIL gate writes its own hash-pinned artifact (inputs, seeds, statistic, threshold, boolean) INCLUDING one designed-to-fail assertion shown failing; gate set is live iff Gate 3 fires.

gate0_sha_and_freshness.seed_convention: confirm = first_draw + 1000, registered convention doc 69 §4 item 4 / doc 70 §2.2

gate3_designed_to_fail.description: S-shuffle-n3_T2 at seed=99 (scrambled labels, 2 epochs) must NOT clear the registered exp78b floor bar 0.5678. If scr_clears=True the gate set is not live.
gate3_designed_to_fail.bar_source: exp78b first-draw: floor_mean(0.4793)+2*floor_sd(0.0442)=0.5678; from results_exp78b.json; cited as smoke reference only -- confirm floor bar re-derived from confirm checkpoints
gate3_designed_to_fail.design_rationale: A floor arm after 2 epochs of training cannot clear a bar calibrated on 150-epoch performance; showing this False proves the gate is live.
